description: Shooting Star on a dark plinth beside Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Bulvarı in Gültepe Mahallesi, Batman city. No contributor has linked a serial so tail_number is deliberately blank. Confirmed present on Esri World Imagery examined September 2026, which resolves a white aircraft on a raised dark plinth in a landscaped strip beside the boulevard.
museum_name: Batman Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Bulvarı T-33 Monument
